guard: `cotal up --no-manager` brings up the broker and, in auth mode, the delivery daemon, and no manager: no manager pidfile is written, no manager process exists, while the broker and the delivery daemon answer. A refresh of a mesh whose manager is live under the flag refuses with the exact `cotal down manager` remedy instead of silently keeping or stopping one (#1417)
why: The suite drives the shipped binary (`tsx bin/cotal.ts`) on real JWT-authed brokers with pidfile + process liveness checks, so a mutant that re-adds `ensureManager` on the broker-only path is observed as a live manager process and its pidfile, not inferred from a source string.

The mutation removes exactly the broker-only early return in `ensureControlPlane`, leaving the delivery half and every refusal untouched, so a red must come from the no-manager cells: the summary line without `manager`, the absent pidfile, or the down path — each names what it asserts.

mutations.name: drop the flag's effect in ensureControlPlane (ensureManager runs anyway)
mutations.find: if (o.noManager) return { running: false, delivery: deliveryStarted, responderBound: delivery.responderBound };
mutations.expectRed: broker-only up reports the exact running component set (no manager)
mutations.cell: broker-only up reports the exact running component set (no manager)
mutations.note: With the early return gone, `ensureControlPlane` falls through to `ensureManager` under the flag too, so the section-4 boot spawns a live manager. The FIRST cell that can notice is the summary line — `✓ running in the background` then lists `manager`, so the exact-component-set cell named by expectRed throws on its regex — followed by `broker-only boot writes no manager pidfile` and `broker-only down leaves no manager pidfile behind` on the same cause (the throw aborts before they run; named here so the verdict cannot be argued from them). The refresh-refusal cells stay green under this mutant by design: the refusal reads the manager record BEFORE the control plane is ensured, so it proves the refresh guard, not the omission.
